item.title: Yuge Farm
item.description:
I went to the Yuge Farm in the northern Kobe.

We can see cows closely in the farm. When I visited, there was a baby cow which was born a week before. I was surprised that he was great in size in spite of being only one week old.

Then, the milk there was very very delicious! It was quite different from the one in grocery stores. Besides, different from what I drunk in UK, though It was delicious too. If I visit next time, I will not forget to bring a freezer bag, and I want to buy some of milk for house.

item.title: Great Zelkova Tree of Noma
item.description:
I just went to Noma No Ookeyaki (Great Zelkova Tree Of Noma) to see the brown hawk-owl today. Brown hawk-owl comes there to lay eggs between late March to mid May and Ural owl, between mid May to last July.

Good roasted coffee was sold very nearby, so I have drunk it and I was relaxed seeing the big tree.

item.title: Cafe Poko no Mori, a cafe where you can meet birds
item.description:
“Torimi” means bird watching. We can meet many kinds of small birds. It is near Oji Zoo. We went there after visiting the zoo.

Touching birds wasn’t allowed in this cafe, unlike other bird cafes. However, through the glass, birds came near me! My favorite type of birds is cockatiels, but he was very active and restless, so it was difficult to take pictures.

Both drinks and sweets were related to birds. They were so pretty! We could request a drawing over the cake plate, then my company ordered a quail. I ordered a cockatiel formed parfait.
